descripcion_geo: People mentioned along with Tubal and Gog in the genealogies of Genesis 10 and in the oracles of Ezekiel; identified with peoples of the Caucasus.
importancia_estrategica: Northern people associated with Gog and Tubal in the eschatological prophecy of Ezekiel.

historias.titulo: Meshech and Tubal in the genealogy of Noah
historias.descripcion: In the table of nations, Meshech and Tubal are sons of Japheth; They represent peoples from the northern Mediterranean.
Ezekiel identifies 'Gog of the land of Magog, prince of Meshech and Tubal' as the eschatological enemy of the north.
Psalm 120 laments: 'Woe is me who dwells in Meshech!' como imagen de estar entre gente hostil.

personajes.descripcion: He identified Meshech as part of Gog's coalition in recent times.
He leads Meshech and Tubal in the final attack against Israel.
Father of Meshech and Tubal in the table of nations.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Meshech: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Meshech and Tubal represent the people of the extreme north, beyond the known world; Gog's attack from the north is the paradigm of the eschatological threat.
